# The Association of Stage Pyrotechnicians (ASP)

> > The Association of Stage Pyrotechnicians (ASP) is the UK's leading organization for theatrical pyrotechnics safety training, operator certification, and professional standards.

ASP provides comprehensive training courses, certification programs, and operator registration services for stage pyrotechnicians working in theatrical and live event environments. The organization works closely with Local Authority Licensing Departments, Fire Services, and Insurance Companies to promote safe practices across venues including Gordon Craig Theatre in Stevenage, Warwick Arts Centre in Coventry, and Fareham Live.
